_comment: Drift-to-canonical label mapping for the Phase 1 bootstrap annotator's output.  Keys are the labels Claude has emitted; values are the canonical label.  Absent labels are identity (already canonical).  Maintained by hand: open the annotation.conf produced by bin/brat_export after each bootstrap run, eyeball drift pairs (same anatomy, different label string), and add them here.  Consumed by notebooks/heaps_law_analysis.ipynb (computes drift fraction) and any future canonicalization Pass.
